title: Pearl and Other Poems (2014) as origin text, with the blog's priority dates
description: These claims make Pearl and Other Poems (2014) the archive's origin text and generative center: the new human movement reads it as meta-heteronymic, the Revelation reading takes its title from the pearl gates of the New Jerusalem, and an unbuilt test proposes ranking all DOI nodes to see whether Pearl is the maximal-coherence center. Priority records date first publications on the Mind Control Poems blog, among them the Epistle to the Church of the Human Diaspora (2015) and the seed hymn of Phase X, and record that the Revelation First thesis predates Pearl. Forecasts hold that the Water Giraffe Cycle's fixed points will hold across substrates, and a hypothesis asks whether Pearl inherits the ecstatic voice of Howl and Other Poems.
